description: 📌 Checkmyguest offers a charming apartment located in the heart of Paris's 2nd arrondissement, close to Le Marais, Les Halles, and the Centre Pompidou. Modern and thoughtfully designed, it provides the perfect setting for a Parisian getaway. You'll enjoy a central location, just steps from museums, boutiques, cafés, restaurants, and public transport, making it easy to explore the French capital.The space⭐ Fully redesigned and carefully furnished, this stunning 131 m² air-conditioned Haussmann-style apartment, located on the 5th floor with elevator, embodies Parisian elegance at its finest. Spacious, bright, and featuring a balcony, it offers a refined and welcoming living space, ideal for up to 8 guests. Generous volumes, high-quality finishes, and premium amenities create a chic, comfortable, and warm atmosphere—perfect for an exceptional Parisian stay.📍 Ideally located in the highly sought-after 2nd arrondissement of Paris, you will enjoy a central location allowing you to explore the city on foot. Close to Le Marais, Rue de Rivoli, and Châtelet, you can easily reach the Louvre Museum, Opéra Garnier, Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, and the Champs-Élysées by foot or public transport. This lively and vibrant neighborhood is filled with shops, restaurants, cafés, and offers excellent public transport connections for effortless travel throughout Paris.⭐ A space designed for your comfort:📍 Living area✔️ A spacious and elegant living room with sofa, armchairs, side table, TV, and decorative fireplace✔️ A welcoming dining area with a large dining table✔️ A fully equipped kitchen: coffee machine, kettle, toaster, stovetop, oven, microwave, dishwasher, washing machine, and refrigerator📍 Sleeping areas✔️ Master Suite 1: double bed, storage space, and private en-suite bathroom wi

enrichment.summary: Four bedrooms with four separate beds, four showers and two WCs are described. The apartment is on the 5th floor with a lift. It has an equipped kitchen and a large dining table, but the listing does not state the number of seats. Hallway renovations are noted through mid-November; stair-free access is unconfirmed.

photoReview.bestPhotoReason: Wide, bright view of the main living room and dining area.
issues: The listing notes renovation work in the entrance hall and stairwell until mid-November.
A lift is advertised, but the available evidence does not establish step-free access to required rooms.

themes: Guests praise the location, design, cleanliness, spaciousness, comfortable beds and effective AC.
Multiple guests describe positive stays and praise the elevator or host responsiveness.
concerns: One guest says a single key set was restrictive.
One guest says the listing did not clearly state the toilet count; another reports that only two of four bathrooms had toilets, leaving three bedrooms sharing one WC.
One guest reports limited towels and toiletries and a very small elevator; that same guest describes the surrounding street and building areas as loud and dirty.
One guest suggests a more opaque curtain in Bedroom 1.
